name: fx_a_battle_gato_front
doc: battle_gato_front's steps in the game started after the attract demo (fx_a_newgame): GATO's exhibit by the reference's way: after Marle joins, the party leaves the fair to the 1000 A.D. overworld (as forest_entry) and comes back in (loc 005 from the south, up the north stairs to loc 1B7, the plaza), then gato_front's walk west into loc 006 and up to GATO. The detour matters to the battle bakes: the overworld leaves its sparkle in OBJ tiles 0x05/0x15 (the naming screen had cleared them) and the plaza's NPCs leave the OBJ palettes the GATO captures have (gato_press_action.state: E4 B2/8B/10/A1 in slots 0/2/3/4; here 8B/10/A1 sit in slots 3/4/2 -- the order they were claimed, which this walk does not reproduce); Crono stands at (134,164) facing GATO and Marle at (137,164) as there (a step right and back: the follower closes to 3 px). Then 4 idle frames before the talk: they set the sound processor's phase under GATO's song, on which the fight's sound handshakes land (with them the cartridge's fights from this state end on the frames the owner's capture gave; with 0-3 or 5-8 a late action of enemies 09, D8 and E3 closes a frame sooner).
